gold.user: As a project manager, I want to retrieve a list of custom field configurations for my Jira project to ensure that all necessary fields are properly set up.
gold.ideal: The API should return a list of custom field configurations, including field IDs, names, and their associated contexts.

gold.user: As a developer, I need to get the configuration details of a specific custom field by its ID or key to understand how it is set up in the project.
gold.ideal: The API should return the configuration details of the specified custom field, including its context, options, and any validation rules.

gold.user: As a system administrator, I want to update the configuration of a custom field to reflect new requirements for data entry in our Jira issues.
gold.ideal: The API should accept the updated configuration details and return a success message confirming that the custom field configuration has been updated.
